name: noctui
description: A React renderer for terminal user interfaces.
author: Pro203S

scripts.pack: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.test:input-types: npm run build && tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --strict --target ES2022 --module Node16 --moduleResolution Node16 --types node,react test/types/input.test.ts
scripts.test:reconciler-runtime: tsc --noCheck --rootDir src --outDir .cache/reconciler-runtime && tsc-alias --outDir .cache/reconciler-runtime && node --test test/runtime/cliMgr.test.mjs test/runtime/layout-text.test.mjs test/runtime/layout-view.test.mjs test/runtime/reconciler.test.mjs test/runtime/renderer.test.mjs
scripts.test:reconciler-types: tsc --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --noCheck --rootDir src --outDir .cache/reconciler-types && tsc-alias --outDir .cache/reconciler-types && tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --strict --target ES6 --module Node16 --moduleResolution Node16 --types node test/types/reconciler.test.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:input-runtime && npm run test:input-types
